options.description: auth

options.description: Default locale

options.description: Instance name

options.description: Configuration for the PoWA service, if enabled in site settings

options.description: Replication slots in this instance (non-exhaustive list)

options.description: Settings for the PostgreSQL instance

options.description: Runtime state
